assumptions: Single selected currency; no FX or tax treatment inferred.
Shared charges use explicit amounts or owner-supplied weights; rational allocation is exact before display rounding.

Recipe lines default to required_input. An explicit net_before_loss line divides by its selected yield percentage; required_input lines cannot also apply that factor. Each recipe states standard additional costs, including zero.
Actual costs consume recorded lots and upstream batches; sold quantity and downstream usage cannot exceed good output.

Revenue is explicitly gross or net realized. Rate fees use recorded revenue, without compounding. Fees marked already_in_revenue are disclosed but not deducted again. Returns/credits require explicit treatment.
Known portions remain visible; incomplete scope is not a complete margin or accounting result.
Rounded display uses eight decimal places; exact rational numerator/denominator accompanies every calculated amount.
